title: Samurai Troopers Perfection
originalTitle: サムライトルーパー　PERFECTION　完全版
summary: A complete-edition book with a three-part TV digest, Gaiden film pages, parody manga, armor-up and special-attack film sequences, armor legend notes, episode commentary, Gaiden profiles, voice-actor talk, and animation-director interview. The Murase cover, transformation frames, and rare voice-actor discussion are highlighted.
